segments.ja530:4.3: Vāḷabījani [vā ḷavījanī (sī. pī.)] muṇhīsaṃ, khaggaṃ chattañcupāhanaṃ;
segments.ja530:9.3: Aticiṇṇo mayā dhammo, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito.
segments.ja530:11.3: Tassa ce vacanaṃ kayirā, nāssa maggeyya kaṇṭako.
segments.ja530:12.3: Tassa ce vacanaṃ kayirā, na so gaccheyya duggatiṃ.
segments.ja530:13.3: Adhammo nirayaṃ neti, dhammo pāpeti suggatiṃ.
segments.ja530:14.3: Yaṃ gatiṃ pecca gacchanti, niraye te suṇohi me.
segments.ja530:15.1: “Sañjīvo kāḷasutto ca, saṅghāto [saṅkhāṭo (syā. ka.)] dve ca roruvā;
segments.ja530:15.3: Athāparo mahāvīci, tāpano [tapano (sī. pī.)] ca patāpano.
segments.ja530:19.3: Samantā yojanasataṃ, phuṭā [pharitvā (a. ni.3.36; pe. va.71)] tiṭṭhanti sabbadā.
segments.ja530:23.5: Yaṃ yañhi dvāraṃ gacchanti, taṃ tadeva pidhīyare [pithiyyati (sī.), pithiyyare (syā.), pithīyare (pī.)].
segments.ja530:24.3: Bāhā paggayha kandanti, patvā dukkhaṃ anappakaṃ.
segments.ja530:27.3: Tālova mūlato [samūlo (ka.)] chinno, sa rājā vibhavaṅgato.
segments.ja530:29.3: Aññoññaṃ [aññamaññaṃ (sī. pī.)] musalā [musale (sī. syā. pī.)] hantvā, sampattā yamasādhanaṃ [yamasādanaṃ (pī.)].
segments.ja530:30.3: Pāvekkhi pathaviṃ [paṭhaviṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] cecco, hīnatto pattapariyāyaṃ.
segments.ja530:32.1: “Manasā ce paduṭṭhena, yo naro pekkhate muniṃ;
segments.ja530:33.3: Anapaccā adāyādā, tālavatthu [tālavatthū (syā.), tālāvatthu (pī.)] bhavanti te.
segments.ja530:36.1: “So ca vassasahassāni [vassasahassānaṃ (sī. syā.)], sataṃ dibbāni paccati;
segments.ja530:37.3: Tejobhakkhassa gattāni, lomehi ca [lomaggehi ca (sī. syā. pī.)] nakhehi ca.
segments.ja530:39.1: “Yo lobhā pitaraṃ hanti, dosā vā purisādhamo;
segments.ja530:40.1: “Sa tādiso paccati lohakumbhiyaṃ, pakkañca sattīhi hananti nittacaṃ;
segments.ja530:40.3: Andhaṃ karitvā muttakarīsabhakkhaṃ, khāre nimujjanti tathāvidhaṃ naraṃ.
segments.ja530:41.3: Vikkhambhamādāya vibandha [vibaddha (sī.), vibhajja (syā. pī.)] rajjubhi, vivaṭe mukhe sampavisanti [saṃcavanti (sī. syā. pī.)] rakkhasā.
segments.ja530:42.1: “Sāmā ca soṇā sabalā ca gijjhā, kākoḷasaṅghā ca dijā ayomukhā;
segments.ja530:42.3: Saṅgamma khādanti vipphandamānaṃ, jivhaṃ vibhajja vighāsaṃ salohitaṃ.
segments.ja530:43.3: Ratī hi nesaṃ dukhino panītare, etādisasmiṃ niraye vasanti;
segments.ja530:44.1: “Putto ca mātaraṃ hantvā, ito gantvā yamakkhayaṃ;
segments.ja530:46.1: “Tamassavaṃ [taṃ passavaṃ (sī. syā.), taṃ passutaṃ (pī.)] sakā gattā, ruhiraṃ [rudhiraṃ (sī. syā.)] attasambhavaṃ;
segments.ja530:48.3: Chaviṃ bhetvāna [chetvāna (sī. pī.)] khādanti, saṃgiddhā [pagiddhā (sī. syā. pī.)] maṃsalohite.
segments.ja530:49.1: “So ca taṃ nirayaṃ patto, nimuggo sataporisaṃ;
segments.ja530:51.3: Patanti gabbhapātiyo [gabbhapātiniyo (sī. syā. pī.)], duggaṃ vetaraṇiṃ [vettaraṇiṃ (syā. ka.)] nadiṃ.
segments.ja530:52.3: Ubhato abhilambanti, duggaṃ vetaraṇiṃ [vettaraṇiṃ (syā. ka.)] nadiṃ.
segments.ja530:54.1: “Ete vajanti [sajanti (sī. pī.), pajjanti (syā.)] niraye, tatte tikhiṇakaṇṭake;
segments.ja530:54.3: Nāriyo ca aticārā [aticāriniyo (sī. syā. pī.)], narā ca paradāragū.
segments.ja530:55.3: Sayanti vinividdhaṅgā, dīghaṃ jagganti sabbadā [saṃvariṃ (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja530:56.1: “Tato ratyā vivasāne [vivasane (sī. syā. pī.)], mahatiṃ pabbatūpamaṃ;
segments.ja530:57.1: “Evaṃ divā ca ratto ca, dussīlā mohapārutā;
segments.ja530:58.3: Sassuṃ vā sasuraṃ vāpi, jeṭṭhaṃ vāpi nanandaraṃ [nanandanaṃ (syā. ka.)].
segments.ja530:59.3: Sa byāmamattaṃ kiminaṃ, jivhaṃ passati attani [attano (sī. syā.)];
segments.ja530:59.5: Viññāpetuṃ na sakkoti, tāpane pecca paccati.
segments.ja530:62.3: Tato vantaṃ durattānaṃ, paresaṃ bhuñjare [bhuñjate (sī. syā. pī.)] sadā.
segments.ja530:64.1: “Ye migena migaṃ hanti, pakkhiṃ vā pana pakkhinā;
segments.ja530:64.3: Asanto rajasā channā, gantā [gatā (ka.)] te nirayussadaṃ [nirayaṃ adho (pī.)].
segments.ja530:65.3: Suciṇṇassa phalaṃ passa, saindā [sahindā (sī.)] devā sabrahmakā.
segments.ja530:66.1: “Taṃ taṃ brūmi mahārāja, dhammaṃ raṭṭhapatī cara;
segments.ja530:66.3: Tathā [tathā tathā (sī. syā. pī.)] rāja carāhi dhammaṃ, yathā taṃ suciṇṇaṃ nānutappeyya pacchā”ti.
